title: Phase Changes & Energy相变与能量

slides.h:
🌡️ Phase Changes & Energy相变与能量

The six phase changes六种相变

Frost appears on a car window overnight without ever being liquid water — which of the six phase changes is that?一夜之间，车窗上结了霜，中间从来没有变成过液态水——这是六种相变中的哪一种？

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · The six phase changes六种相变
  1. s→l melting · l→s freezing · l→g evaporation · g→l condensation固→液 熔化 · 液→固 凝固 · 液→气 汽化 · 气→液 液化
  2. s→g sublimation · g→s deposition (both skip the liquid)固→气 升华 · 气→固 凝华（都跳过液态）
  3. All are physical changes. Toward gas absorbs energy; away from gas releases it.都是物理变化。朝气态吸收能量；离开气态放出能量。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · The six phase changes六种相变

Particles in the three states三种状态中的粒子

🧗 The hard part难点 · The six phase changes六种相变

Sublimation vs deposition升华与凝华

Both skip the liquid, so students swap them.两者都跳过液态，学生常常搞反。

  1. Find the START state.找出起始状态。
  2. Starts solid → sublimation. Starts gas → deposition.从固体开始 → 升华；从气体开始 → 凝华。
Try试一试
How many of the six phase changes skip the liquid state?六种相变中有几种跳过液态？
Answer答案
2 (sublimation and deposition).2 种（升华和凝华）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · The six phase changes六种相变
  • Frost = freezing ✗ → frost = deposition (vapour → ice) ✓霜＝凝固 ✗ → 霜＝凝华（水蒸气 → 冰）✓
🟡
Your class diagram names liquid → gas "evaporation". Many textbooks call it "vaporization" and split it into evaporation (at the surface, below the boiling point) and boiling (throughout the liquid, at the boiling point). On this test, "evaporation" is the expected name; on the heating curve, the flat step at 100 °C is called "boiling".课堂笔记的三角图把「液 → 气」叫做「汽化（evaporation）」。很多教科书称之为 vaporization，并细分为表面汽化（低于沸点）和沸腾（整个液体内部、在沸点）。本次考试答「evaporation 汽化」即可；加热曲线上 100 °C 的平台则叫「沸腾」。
🎯
Write "start → end" in states first; the name follows from the triangle.先写「起始状态 → 最终状态」，名字从三角图上读出来。

🌡️ Phase Changes & Energy相变与能量

Heating curve of water水的加热曲线

The burner under a pot of ice water is on full, yet the thermometer is stuck at 0 °C for minutes — where is all that heat going?一锅冰水下面的火开到最大，温度计却好几分钟都停在 0 °C——那么多热量跑到哪里去了？

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Heating curve of water水的加热曲线
  1. Diagonal = temperature changing (one phase). Horizontal = phase changing (two phases), T constant.斜线＝温度变（一个相）。水平线＝相变（两个相），温度不变。
  2. Water: 1 ice warms · 2 melts at 0 °C · 3 liquid warms · 4 boils at 100 °C · 5 steam warms.水：1 冰升温 · 2 0 °C 熔化 · 3 液体升温 · 4 100 °C 沸腾 · 5 水蒸气升温。
  3. Flat because energy breaks attractions or separates particles, not speeding them up.平台是因为能量用来打破吸引或分开粒子，而不是让粒子加速。
diagonal⇒temperature changes;horizontal⇒phase changes

🧗 The hard part难点 · Heating curve of water水的加热曲线

Why the temperature stops rising为什么温度不再上升

It feels wrong that adding heat does not raise the temperature.「加热却不升温」违反直觉。

  1. Temperature tracks how fast particles move.温度反映粒子运动的快慢。
  2. On a flat part, energy goes into pulling particles apart.水平段上，能量用来把粒子拉开。
  3. Speed unchanged → temperature unchanged until the phase change is complete.速度不变 → 温度不变，直到相变完成。
Try试一试
Ice at −20 °C is heated to 120 °C. How many flat segments?−20 °C 的冰加热到 120 °C，有几个水平段？
Answer答案
2 (melting at 0 °C, boiling at 100 °C).2 个（0 °C 熔化，100 °C 沸腾）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Heating curve of water水的加热曲线
  • Heat added → temperature must rise ✗ → not on the flat parts ✓加热 → 温度一定升 ✗ → 水平段上不升 ✓
  • Flat part = one phase ✗ → two phases together ✓水平段＝一个相 ✗ → 两个相共存 ✓
🟡
Your class notes put "heat added" on the x-axis. Many textbooks put "time" there instead (with heat added at a steady rate) — the shape and the five segments are exactly the same, so read either graph the same way.课堂笔记的横轴是「加入的热量」。很多教科书横轴写的是「时间」（假设匀速加热）——曲线形状和五段完全一样，两种图读法相同。
🎯
Cooling curve = read right to left: condense at 100 °C, freeze at 0 °C.冷却曲线＝从右往左读：100 °C 液化，0 °C 凝固。

🌡️ Phase Changes & Energy相变与能量

Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动

A water molecule can spin like a top, shake like a spring, or fly across the room — only one of these lets ice melt and water boil.一个水分子可以像陀螺一样转、像弹簧一样抖，也可以飞过整个房间——只有其中一种能让冰熔化、让水沸腾。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动
  1. Kinetic energy = energy of motion; temperature up → faster → more kinetic energy.动能＝运动的能量；温度升 → 更快 → 动能更大。
  2. Rotational spins (bonds same) · vibrational stretches/bends in place · translational moves place to place.转动：旋转（键不变）· 振动：原地伸缩弯曲 · 平动：从一处移到另一处。
  3. Translational energy matters most for phase changes: particles must pull away from each other.平动能对相变最重要：粒子必须彼此拉开。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动
  • Kinetic energy of molecules分子的动能
    • Rotational转动spins; bond lengths & angles unchanged转动；键长、键角不变
    • Vibrational振动stretches & bends; bonds change; stays in place伸缩、弯曲；键改变；位置不变
    • Translational平动moves place to place; bonds unchanged — key for phase change从一处移到另一处；键不变——相变的关键

🧗 The hard part难点 · Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动

Rotational vs vibrational转动与振动

Both happen in place, so students mix them up.两者都在原地发生，学生容易搞混。

  1. Both: molecule stays in the same place.共同点：分子位置不变。
  2. Bonds unchanged → rotational (spinning).键不变 → 转动。
  3. Bonds stretch or bend → vibrational.键伸缩或弯曲 → 振动。
Try试一试
How many of the three motion types keep bond lengths and angles the same?三种运动中，有几种键长和键角保持不变？
Answer答案
2 (rotational and translational).2 种（转动和平动）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动
  • Vibrating molecule moves across the box ✗ → vibration is in place; moving across is translational ✓振动的分子会穿过盒子 ✗ → 振动在原地；穿过盒子是平动 ✓
🟡
Your class graph says a solid gains "vibrational and translational" energy as it warms, while the table says solid particles "mostly vibrate in place". Many textbooks say solid particles only vibrate. On this test: solid = mostly vibrating in place; if asked what increases while a solid warms, give the class answer (vibrational, plus some translational).课堂图上说固体升温时获得「振动和平动」能量，而表格写的是固体粒子「主要在原地振动」。很多教科书说固体粒子只振动。本次考试：固体＝主要在原地振动；若问固体升温时增加的是什么，按课堂答案写（振动，加上少量平动）。
🎯
Two-question test: bonds change? position change? — that names the motion.两问法：键变吗？位置变吗？——就能说出运动类型。

cards.f: Solid → gas directly?固体直接变气体？
cards.b: Sublimation (e.g. dry ice).升华（例：干冰）。

cards.f: Gas → solid directly?气体直接变固体？
cards.b: Deposition (e.g. frost).凝华（例：霜）。

cards.f: Gas → liquid?气体变液体？
cards.b: Condensation (e.g. steam on a mirror).液化（凝结），例：镜子上的水汽。

cards.f: Liquid → gas (class name)?液体变气体（课堂用名）？
cards.b: Evaporation (boiling when it happens at the boiling point).汽化（在沸点发生时叫沸腾）。

cards.f: Physical or chemical: any phase change?相变是物理还是化学变化？
cards.b: Always physical.一律是物理变化。

cards.f: Which three absorb energy?哪三种吸收能量？
cards.b: Melting, evaporation, sublimation (toward gas).熔化、汽化、升华（朝气态方向）。

cards.f: Diagonal line on a heating curve?加热曲线上的斜线？
cards.b: Temperature is changing (one phase warming).温度在变（单一相在升温）。

cards.f: Horizontal line?水平线？
cards.b: Phase is changing; temperature constant; two phases present.相在变；温度不变；两个相共存。

cards.f: Water: melting and boiling temperatures?水的熔点和沸点？
cards.b: 0 °C and 100 °C.0 °C 和 100 °C。

cards.f: Why is the temperature constant during boiling?为什么沸腾时温度不变？
cards.b: Energy separates particles into gas instead of making them move faster.能量用来把粒子分开成气体，而不是让它们跑得更快。

cards.f: Which kinetic energy matters most for a phase change?对相变最重要的是哪种动能？
cards.b: Translational — particles must move away from each other.平动动能——粒子必须彼此远离。

cards.f: Cooling curve flat parts for water?水的冷却曲线有哪两个水平段？
cards.b: Condensation at 100 °C, freezing at 0 °C.100 °C 液化，0 °C 凝固。

cards.f: Kinetic energy?动能？
cards.b: Energy particles have because they are moving.粒子因运动而具有的能量。

cards.f: Temperature increases → ?温度升高 → ？
cards.b: Particles move faster → kinetic energy increases.粒子运动更快 → 动能增大。

cards.f: Rotational?转动？
cards.b: Spins; bond lengths and angles stay the same.转动；键长、键角不变。

cards.f: Vibrational?振动？
cards.b: Bonds stretch and bend; molecule stays in place.键伸缩、弯曲；分子位置不变。

cards.f: Translational?平动？
cards.b: Whole molecule moves place to place; bonds unchanged.整个分子从一处移到另一处；键不变。

cards.f: Most important for phase change?对相变最重要的是？
cards.b: Translational energy.平动能。

quiz.q: Gas turning directly into a solid is called:气体直接变成固体叫做：
opts: sublimation升华
condensation液化（凝结）
deposition凝华
freezing凝固
quiz.hint: Check both the start and the end state.起点和终点都要核对。
quiz.why: Correct: gas → solid = deposition.正确：气 → 固＝凝华。
whys: Reversed the direction: sublimation is solid → gas.方向搞反了：升华是固 → 气。
Condensation ends as a liquid, not a solid.液化的终点是液体，不是固体。
Correct: gas → solid = deposition.正确：气 → 固＝凝华。
Freezing starts from a liquid, not a gas.凝固从液体开始，不是气体。

quiz.q: A block of dry ice (COX2​(s)) gives off white fog and shrinks, but never leaves a puddle. Which description is correct?一块干冰（COX2​(s)）冒出白雾并不断变小，但从不留下液体。哪个描述正确？
opts: Sublimation; a physical change升华；物理变化
Melting; a physical change熔化；物理变化
Sublimation; a chemical change because a gas appears升华；化学变化，因为出现了气体
Evaporation; a physical change汽化；物理变化
quiz.hint: No puddle → no liquid step; same formula → physical.没有液体 → 没有液态这一步；化学式不变 → 物理变化。
quiz.why: Correct: COX2​(s)​COX2​(g), same substance, so physical.正确：COX2​(s)​COX2​(g)，同种物质，所以是物理变化。
whys: Correct: COX2​(s)​COX2​(g), same substance, so physical.正确：COX2​(s)​COX2​(g)，同种物质，所以是物理变化。
Melting would leave a liquid — there is no puddle.熔化会留下液体——但没有液体。
Right name, but thinks any new gas means chemical; the gas is still COX2​.名称对了，但以为出现气体就是化学变化；气体仍是 COX2​。
Evaporation starts from a liquid; dry ice is a solid.汽化从液体开始；干冰是固体。

quiz.q: Water is on the flat part of its heating curve at 0 °C. What is present?水处于加热曲线 0 °C 的水平段上。此时存在什么？
opts: Only ice只有冰
Only liquid water只有液态水
Ice and liquid water冰和液态水
Liquid water and water vapour液态水和水蒸气
quiz.hint: Flat at 0 °C = melting = solid + liquid.0 °C 水平＝熔化＝固＋液。
quiz.why: Correct: during melting both solid and liquid are present.正确：熔化时固体和液体同时存在。
whys: Thinks melting has not started yet — on the plateau it is underway.以为还没开始熔化——在平台上熔化正在进行。
Thinks melting is instant — the ice takes the whole plateau to finish melting.以为熔化瞬间完成——冰要用整个平台的时间才化完。
Correct: during melting both solid and liquid are present.正确：熔化时固体和液体同时存在。
Mixed up the two plateaus: liquid + gas is at 100 °C.把两个平台搞混了：液＋气是在 100 °C。

quiz.q: While water boils at 100 °C, energy is still being added. Where does that energy go?水在 100 °C 沸腾时，能量仍在不断加入。这些能量去哪了？
opts: It speeds up the particles, so the temperature slowly keeps rising.让粒子加速，所以温度还在慢慢上升。
It is lost to the room; nothing happens to the water.散失到房间里；对水没有任何作用。
It breaks water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen gas.把水分子分解成氢气和氧气。
It separates particles from the liquid into the gas phase, so the temperature stays at 100 °C.把粒子从液体中分开、进入气相，所以温度保持 100 °C。
quiz.hint: Follow the energy into the phase change.追踪能量流向相变。
quiz.why: Correct: energy goes into separating particles, not into raising their speed.正确：能量用于分开粒子，而不是提高速度。
whys: Believes added heat always raises temperature; on a plateau it does not.以为加热一定升温；平台上不会。
Does not see that the energy is doing work on the water — the liquid is turning to gas.没意识到能量正作用在水上——液体正在变成气体。
Confuses a physical change with a chemical one: boiling keeps HX2​O as HX2​O.把物理变化和化学变化混淆：沸腾后 HX2​O 仍是 HX2​O。
Correct: energy goes into separating particles, not into raising their speed.正确：能量用于分开粒子，而不是提高速度。

quiz.q: Which describes vibrational motion?哪一项描述的是振动？
opts: Atoms stretch and bend; the molecule stays in place.原子伸缩、弯曲；分子位置不变。
The whole molecule moves from place to place.整个分子从一处移到另一处。
The molecule spins; bond lengths and angles stay the same.分子转动；键长、键角不变。
The molecule breaks apart into separate atoms.分子断开成单个原子。
quiz.hint: Bonds change + stays in place.键改变＋位置不变。
quiz.why: Correct: bonds change, position does not.正确：键改变，位置不变。
whys: Correct: bonds change, position does not.正确：键改变，位置不变。
That is translational — confuses shaking with travelling.那是平动——把抖动和移动混淆了。
That is rotational — confuses spinning with shaking.那是转动——把旋转和抖动混淆了。
Breaking bonds would be a chemical change; vibration only stretches and bends bonds.断键是化学变化；振动只是让键伸缩、弯曲。

quiz.q: According to the class graph, what lets molecules break out of the solid during melting?根据课堂上的图，熔化时是什么让分子挣脱固体？
opts: Their rotational energy drops to zero.转动能降到零。
Their translational energy reaches a critical value.平动能达到临界值。
The bonds inside each water molecule break.每个水分子内部的键断开。
The temperature rises above 0 °C first.温度先升到 0 °C 以上。
quiz.hint: Breaking out of a phase needs movement from place to place.挣脱一个相需要「从一处移到另一处」的运动。
quiz.why: Correct: enough translational energy lets particles move away from their neighbours.正确：平动能足够大时，粒子才能离开周围粒子。
whys: Energy is being added, not removed; no type of kinetic energy drops to zero.能量是在加入而不是减少；没有哪种动能会降到零。
Correct: enough translational energy lets particles move away from their neighbours.正确：平动能足够大时，粒子才能离开周围粒子。
Confuses melting (physical) with breaking molecules apart (chemical).把熔化（物理变化）和分子分解（化学变化）混淆。
Melting happens AT 0 °C on a flat segment; the temperature does not rise until all the ice has melted.熔化发生在 0 °C 的水平段上；冰全部熔化前温度不会上升。
